header: Optimizing query performance for Amazon OpenSearch Service data sources
content:
Service data sources
Query performance in Amazon OpenSearch Service might slow down when you’re accessing
external data sources. This can be due to factors like network latency, data transformation, or large
data volumes. To improve performance, consider indexing select amounts of data depending on
the use case:
